question.text: The Investment Manager for the Nilgiri Multi-Strategy Fund (a Category III AIF) must comply with certain registration requirements with SEBI. Which requirement is a mandatory organisational position under current SEBI (AIF) framework?

answer.text: Only a Chief Investment Officer (CIO) is mandatory; Compliance Officer is optional.
Both a Chief Investment Officer and a Compliance Officer are mandatorily required.
Only a Compliance Officer is mandatory; CIO is optional.
Neither role is mandated; the sponsor decides based on fund size.

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook requires the Investment Manager of an AIF to appoint a Compliance Officer responsible for monitoring compliance with the SEBI Act, rules, regulations, and circulars. Key investment team personnel must hold the required certification and professional qualifications, but a Chief Investment Officer is not named as a mandatory organisational position. The Trap: Options that elevate the CIO to a mandatory named position go beyond the workbook text; option D ignores the explicit Compliance Officer requirement. Note: Per workbook page 344 for the Compliance Officer requirement and pages 385-386 for key investment team criteria.
